author: Telos II
title: Data Consolidation: Repair Corrupted Log File
abstract: This script repairs the corrupted 'all_transgen_logs.jsonl' file. It reads the file, which contains concatenated and malformed JSON objects, splits them into fragments, parses each fragment to extract the required data (evaluation_id, generation_id, final_collective_reward), and reconstructs the file in the correct, clean JSONL format with 10 entries.
